result.one_liner: Freshdesk is a cloud-based customer support platform enabling teams to manage tickets, contacts, and support interactions through a REST API.

evidence.quote: Freshdesk uses HTTP Basic Auth, where your API key is the username and any arbitrary string (like 'X') is the password.
Importantly, the main limitations of the Freshdesk free plan are the lack of automation, API access, and advanced reporting.
if you need API access, you'll need to subscribe to at least the Growth plan ($19/agent/month)
The Freshdesk API is a full CRUD surface over the objects you see in the Freshdesk UI.
Free plan includes: 1-2 agents, Email ticketing, Knowledge base. Growth plan ($19/agent/month): 200 API calls/min

result.notes: API requires paid subscription starting at Growth plan ($19/agent/month). Basic authentication with API key. REST API covers tickets, contacts, companies, agents, and related entities. No MCP server found. Free tier exists but explicitly excludes API access.
